# FIXTURE deny list: comments only, and it must stay that way.
#
# The fixture install's upstream.deny_list names this file. `fleet settings`
# needs it to be a file. The leak gate refuses a deny list with no entries
# (exit 3, "has no entries"), so if this fixture context ever reaches a commit
# hook (FLEET_CONTEXT_ROOT left exported), the commit is refused rather than
# checked against a harmless fixture list in place of the host's own.
#
# Adding an entry here turns that refusal into a pass. A test that needs a deny
# list writes one under its own temporary root and passes it with
# FLEET_LEAK_DENY_FILE.
